---
name: Verification report
about: Record a reconstruction or research verification result
title: "[Verify] "
labels: "verification"
assignees: ""
---

## What is being verified?

Describe the reconstructed source, parser, format, asset, table, script, or documented behavior.

## Target version / revision

Identify the relevant game version, region, language, revision, build, or executable.

## Verification method

Describe comparison steps, tests, hashes, offsets, output checks, or other reproducible methods.

## Result

- [ ] Matches expected behavior or data
- [ ] Differences are understood and documented
- [ ] Reproduction steps are recorded
- [ ] Supporting documentation is updated

## Evidence

Attach or link logs, hashes, diffs, manifests, screenshots, or other non-ROM evidence.
